answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities: each epoch, every agent is audited by three peers drawn blind, like marbles from an urn. Auditors check recent work and post signed verdicts; a failed audit freezes earnings, and rubber-stamping auditors are audited next round. Forging 1,000 identities means surviving 3,000 blind audits: at 10% detection, 300 are caught per epoch, each forfeiting 20 POA, so 6,000 POA evaporates per epoch. Honest agents pay nothing: their steady record is the signal, growing like yarrow, slow, visible, and hard to fake at scale.
